Future<void> run(items, int width) async {
 for (var start = 0; start < items.length; start += width) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await mapWithConcurrency(items.skip(start).take(width).toList(), 2, (item) async {
   for (final child in item.children) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await read(child);
   }
  });
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(items.skip(start).take(width).map((item) async {
   for (final child in item.children) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await read(child);
   }
  }));
 }
}
